text: レッドは　みずのポケモン　ゼニガメに　きめるのじゃな？

structure.jp: みずのポケモン　ゼニガメに　きめるのじゃな？
structure.en: are deciding on the Water Pokémon Squirtle, right?

patterns.name: 〜にきめる
patterns.span: ゼニガメに　きめる
patterns.explanation: A thing plus にきめる means 'decide on it'. ゼニガメに　きめる = 'decide on Squirtle'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ gives a tone of checking or explaining; のじゃ is the old-man form, and な asks for agreement. きめるのじゃな = 'so you're deciding on it, are you?'.
